profile_text.body:
HeyGen is an AI video generation platform that allows users to create videos from text, image, or audio inputs. The company describes its system as built on a five-stage AI training pipeline designed to capture a person's appearance, movement, gestures, and expressions. Its tools include avatar generation, voice cloning, lip-sync translation, captions, and an editing environment called AI Studio, where motion, text, color, and timing can be adjusted without re-rendering. The platform also supports conversion of PowerPoint and PDF files into narrated video scenes, and audio files such as podcasts into avatar-driven video content.

HeyGen's site states the platform supports translation across 175 or more languages and dialects, and lists features including Voice Director, Voice Mirroring, and Gesture Control. The company also offers HyperFrames, described as an open-source video rendering framework that lets AI agents create videos using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Seedance 2.0, a cinematic AI video generation system, is noted as fully integrated into HeyGen. The company reports more than 30 million users, customers across 196 countries, and adoption across 85 percent of the Fortune 100.

The site holds one tracked product, HeyGen itself, categorized under video generation and editing, with a noted risk around likeness and consent. No litigation, MCP server registration, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the held data.
